d4534.Raw_Article: 4534 Ta. poy (-v-, -t-) to fell, throw down. Ma. poyyuka to fight, fence; poyttu fencing, fight, duel. Ko. poy- (poc-) to strike with hand; oy- (oc-) to beat (percussion instruments); poyb wooden paddle used in closing the bottom of a pot before baking. To. pïy- (pïs-) to beat. Ka. poy to beat; n. beating, a blow; puy to beat, smite, strike, kill, throb; puyal, puyyal, poyil, poylu beating, striking. Koḍ. poyy (poyyuv-, pojj-) to beat; poytï a blow. Tu. poyimārů violence, force, pillage. Kuwi (Ṭ.) boyeri , (Isr.) bõyeri vali slab for pounding; (F.) boiyeri vwalli currystone. DED(N) 3704.
